objective: Require specification-first evidence when authoring or opening design and conceptual ARs, while retaining a bounded lighter method for operational ARs.
assumptions: The Coordinator remains the lifecycle authority
The product formal checker is deterministic and offline
unknowns: Different operational ARs may require different lighter formal methods
invariants: Design and conceptual ARs cannot open without exact specification and passed-check evidence
Evidence binds to the Coordinator task revision
Checker limitations are recorded and do not become implementation claims
Unsafe references and stale digests fail closed
Operational ARs still carry a bounded specification
acceptance_predicates: A complete conceptual envelope is accepted
Missing fields, stale revision, failed result, digest mismatch, and path escape are rejected
A lighter operational envelope is accepted only with its bounded method and limitations
The gate does not mutate Coordinator authority
